# Match Maid

> Match Maid is a marketplace that connects households with independent local house cleaners. Rates are shown up front, it is free for households, and cleaners keep 100% of what they charge - Match Maid never takes a commission on a job. It runs two separate marketplaces: New Zealand at matchmaid.co.nz, and Australia at matchmaid.com.au. They do not share listings - an Australian household sees Australian cleaners only, and vice versa.

## What it is
- A directory / marketplace, not a cleaning company. Match Maid introduces households to independent cleaners and does not employ cleaners, take bookings, or handle payments.
- Households browse cleaners, compare rates and reviews, and contact the one they choose. Payment and scheduling are arranged directly between the household and the cleaner.
- Cleaners create a profile, set their own hourly and flat rates, list their suburbs and availability, and receive enquiries directly.

## Why people use it
- For households: rates are visible before you make contact, it is always free, you contact only the one cleaner you pick (no bidding wars or a flood of quotes), and it is built around keeping the same trusted cleaner long term.
- For cleaners: exclusive local enquiries, no commission on jobs, and trust badges (ID verified, criminal check, insured) that help win clients.

## Pricing
- Households: free, always.
- Cleaners: free. Match Maid is free for everyone while we build the network in both countries, and never takes a per-job commission.

## What a clean actually costs - New Zealand
- Cleaners set their own hourly rate and it is shown before you contact anyone.
- Rates currently advertised on Match Maid run from $24 to $60 an hour for a regular clean, most between $35 and $50, with the middle of the market at about $42. A deep clean runs about $29-$80 an hour, most between $50 and $65, middle about $55.
- The lowest rate a cleaner may advertise is $20 an hour.
- There is no booking fee, no commission and no charge to households at any point.

## Coverage - New Zealand (matchmaid.co.nz)
- Open to households and cleaners anywhere in New Zealand. Every suburb in the country is searchable.
- Cleaner numbers are deepest in Auckland and Christchurch, with cleaners also covering parts of Dunedin. Other towns are open and filling in.
- Cleaners set a service area as a radius, so coverage is by suburb rather than by whole city.

## Coverage - Australia (matchmaid.com.au)
- Open in six cities: Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Hobart and Darwin. Accounts can only be created in those cities for now.
- 2,422 suburbs across those six metros are searchable.
- Prices are in Australian dollars. Advertised rates run from about A$35 to A$80 an hour depending on the city, with most around A$45-$55. The lowest rate an Australian cleaner may advertise is A$30 an hour - above the casual minimum wage.
- Same model as New Zealand: free for households, no commission from cleaners, rates shown before you make contact.

## Australian cities
- [All cities](https://matchmaid.com.au/cleaners): the six metros in one place.
- [Sydney](https://matchmaid.com.au/cleaners/sydney), [Melbourne](https://matchmaid.com.au/cleaners/melbourne), [Brisbane](https://matchmaid.com.au/cleaners/brisbane), [Perth](https://matchmaid.com.au/cleaners/perth), [Hobart](https://matchmaid.com.au/cleaners/hobart), [Darwin](https://matchmaid.com.au/cleaners/darwin)

## What a clean actually costs - the page
- [House cleaning prices in New Zealand](https://matchmaid.co.nz/house-cleaning-prices): advertised rates by clean type, what a visit costs by home size, and the five things that move the price.

## Cleaning services - New Zealand
- [End of tenancy cleaning](https://matchmaid.co.nz/end-of-tenancy-cleaning): bond / move-out cleans, what they cover, what they cost, and which cleaners offer a bond-back guarantee.
- [Deep cleaning](https://matchmaid.co.nz/deep-cleaning): what a deep clean includes over a regular one, how long it takes, and real rates.
- Only cleans with cleaners actually offering them get a page: regular, deep and end-of-tenancy. Carpet, oven and window cleans exist as service types but have no supply, so there is no page for them.

## Cleaners by city - New Zealand
- [Auckland](https://matchmaid.co.nz/cleaners/auckland): about $25-$50 an hour for a regular clean.
- [Christchurch](https://matchmaid.co.nz/cleaners/christchurch): about $24-$60 an hour for a regular clean.
